ja.html: たぶんフリッドマンという男が、贋作を売りつけるのは一度や二度ではないのだろう。まったく恐ろしい男だ。

en.text: I doubt this is only Fridman's first or second time selling a fake. What a frightening man.
en.html: I doubt this is only Fridman's first or second time selling a fake. What a frightening man.

ja.text: 問題は贋作だ。
ja.html: 問題は贋作だ。

en.text: The forgeries themselves are the problem.
en.html: The forgeries themselves are the problem.

ja.text: これに関しては、明石もフリッドマンもまったくアイディアはない。
ja.html: これに関しては、明石もフリッドマンもまったくアイディアはない。

en.text: Neither Akashi nor Fridman has the faintest idea how they can be made.
en.html: Neither Akashi nor Fridman has the faintest idea how they can be made.

ja.text: すべては俺に一任されている。
ja.html: すべては俺に一任されている。

en.text: That's all up to me.
en.html: That's all up to me.

ja.text: 俺の贋作が中途半端なものであれば、そもそもこの計画は成り立たない。
ja.html: 俺の贋作が中途半端なものであれば、そもそもこの計画は成り立たない。

en.text: If my forgeries are half-baked, the plan won't work at all.
en.html: If my forgeries are half-baked, the plan won't work at all.

ja.text: プロが見ても、贋作だと見抜けぬ物。
ja.html: プロが見ても、贋作だと見抜けぬ物。

en.text: Even a professional must be unable to distinguish them from genuine works.
en.html: Even a professional must be unable to distinguish them from genuine works.

ja.text: それがフリッドマンの要求だ。

en.text: That is Fridman's demand.

en.text: The plan is for the Moore Foundation to expose the fakes when Nakamura sells them. They managed Dad's schedule, so their verdict would rest solely on his never having had time to paint them while he was alive.
en.html: The plan is for the Moore Foundation to expose the fakes when Nakamura sells them. They managed Dad's schedule, so their verdict would rest solely on his never having had time to paint them while he was alive.

ja.text:
そういった意味では、贋作としての判断がつくには相当時間がかかるだろう。
「生前にその様なものを作った時間はない」は、ややもすると悪魔の証明になり得る。
ja.html:
そういった意味では、贋作としての判断がつくには相当時間がかかるだろう。
「生前にその様なものを作った時間はない」は、ややもすると悪魔の証明になり得る。

en.text: That could take a long time to establish. Saying he never had time to paint them could turn into trying to prove a negative.
en.html: That could take a long time to establish. Saying he never had time to paint them could turn into trying to prove a negative.

たとえば長年、睡眠時間を一部削っていた。あるいは実は『横たわる櫻』完成と同時期に完成させていた。
等、可能性自体はいくらでも後付で出てくる。

en.text: Maybe he'd been cutting back on sleep for years. Maybe he finished them around the same time as The Reclining Cherry Tree. You could come up with any number of possibilities after the fact.
en.html: Maybe he'd been cutting back on sleep for years. Maybe he finished them around the same time as The Reclining Cherry Tree. You could come up with any number of possibilities after the fact.

en.text: It will probably take a long time to decide whether they're real or fake.
en.html: It will probably take a long time to decide whether they're real or fake.

ja.text: うまくいけば、真作として流通するかもしれない。

en.text: With luck, they might circulate as genuine works.
en.html: With luck, they might circulate as genuine works.

その場合は、中村章一も得をするが、我々が危険にさらされる事が無くなる。

その場合は、中村章一も得をするが、我々が危険にさらされる事が無くなる。

en.text: Shouichi Nakamura would profit too, but we'd be out of danger. The best outcome for both sides.
en.html: Shouichi Nakamura would profit too, but we'd be out of danger. The best outcome for both sides.

ja.text: その状況を担保するためには、作品の絶対的な完成度が必要となる。

en.text: For that to happen, the work has to be flawless.
en.html: For that to happen, the work has to be flawless.

en.html: Even a professional appraiser has to say, without a doubt, ‘Kenichirou Kusanagi painted these.’
